title: Understanding the Model
text: The model includes the variable 'veg' and dummy variables for 'meat'. Removing 'veg' will affect the model's ability to predict the total based on the amount of vegetables bought.

title: Impact on Variance
text: Variance refers to how much the model's predictions will change with different training data. Removing a variable like 'veg' can increase variance because the model has less information to base its predictions on.

title: Impact on Bias
text: Bias refers to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem with a simplified model. Removing 'veg' might increase bias because the model loses a predictor that helps explain the variation in the total bill.
